companies.name: ガルプ・エネルジア
companies.sub: 石油・ガス(ポルトガル)

relations.text: PEL83鉱区(Mopane発見)の40%を取得する契約
relations.text_en: Agreed to acquire a 40% operated interest in the PEL83 license (Mopane)

source.label: TotalEnergies 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: The Company signed an agreement with Galp to acquire a 40% operated interest in the prolific PEL83 license, which includes the Mopane discovery.

companies.name: EPH
companies.sub: 発電・エネルギー(チェコ)

relations.text: 発電資産(14GW超)の50%を取得する契約
relations.text_en: Agreed to acquire 50% of a 14 GW+ flexible power portfolio

source.label: TotalEnergies 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: TotalEnergies signed an agreement with EPH to acquire 50% of a portfolio of flexible power generation assets with more than 14 GW of gross capacity.

companies.name: YPF
companies.sub: 石油・ガス(アルゼンチン)

relations.text: Vaca Muertaの2鉱区の45%を5億ドルで売却
relations.text_en: Sold 45% interests in two Vaca Muerta blocks for $500 million

source.label: TotalEnergies 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: its affiliate Total Austral has signed an agreement with YPF SA for the sale of its 45 % operated interest in two unconventional oil and gas blocks in Argentina, Rincon La Ceniza and La Escalonada, located in the Vaca Muerta area in the Neuquén Basin, for an amount of $ 500 million.

relations.text: 英国の上流事業を統合し、新会社の筆頭株主(47.5%)になる契約
relations.text_en: Agreed to merge its UK upstream business into NEO NEXT, becoming top shareholder (47.5%)

source.label: TotalEnergies 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: TotalEnergies signed an agreement with NEO NEXT Energy Limited (NEO NEXT) under which the Company's upstream activities in the United Kingdom would be merged with NEO NEXT. TotalEnergies would become the main shareholder of the new enlarged entity, renamed NEO NEXT+, with a 47.5 % stake

relations.text_en: Co-partner in the Kharyaga joint venture (30%)

source.label: TotalEnergies 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Kharyaga is a non-incorporated joint venture with Zarubezhneft (operator, 40%), Equinor (30%) and Nenets Oil Company (10%).
